_note:
Animation slice S3 (aseprite-source/catfish/cf_frames_s3.lua + cf_overlays_s3.lua). Layer roles: body = cf-cat-grey-; pat-

= cf-pat-

-grey-; ears-folded/ears-mask, tail-bobtail/tail-mask, eyes- = cf--. Grey template names: recolour per coat as for every frame. kind full = every layer is the frame's own, named with the frame. kind alias = the body is own; each other layer is either own (its file named with the alias frame) or the base frame's file, as listed in files. Stack order as tools/catfish_recolor.py compose(): body, clear ear/tail masks from body and pattern, parts, pattern, eyes. Every alias stack was checked pixel-equal to the stack of layers computed for the alias frame itself. Eye split (odd eyes): jump x = 32, happy has closed eyes (no iris; 25), aliases as idleA (25).

jump.notes: Straight-up leap drawn at ground level (feet on idleA's floor line); add the 16 px translateY arc in code. Eyes open.

happy.notes: After a catch: happy squint (eye files are empty, like catch), open smile, tail high, little hop with a floor shadow in the frame.

tailflick.notes: idleA with only the tail moved (up high, tip hooked back). Patterns that mark the tail are own; a bobtail cat shows no flick (none=same tabby=same tuxedo=same calico=same pointed=same spotted=same against idleA+bobtail).

eartwitch.notes: idleA with the right ear tip tilted 2 px out and 2 px down (base fixed); a folded right flap drops 1,1. Patterns that mark the ears are own.
